text_block_list.text:
The first leg of the Classic Triple Crown, 
the Satsuki Sho. The rival standing in her 
way is...
—She was not an Umamusume.
(Knock knock!)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Beep, beep...
Excuse me.

Before the race, an unexpected visitor. 
The one who entered was—

"Long time no see, Neo Universe. And nice 
to meet you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Contact" record exists. This "human" is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A Trainer who was "uncontracted." Yes, 
that day...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I can't seem to communicate well with you. 
To be honest, I have no idea what you're 
saying or feeling...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Besides... The truth is, there was an 
Umamusume who offered me a contract before 
you did.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I want to honor my obligation to her, too. 
So if I have to choose between the two...

Hearing that, it hit me. This was the 
Trainer who hadn't signed a contract with 
Neo Universe due to a prior engagement.

The fact that the Trainer came to say 
hello must mean...
choice_data_list: My trainee is running in the Satsuki Sho?

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we finally managed to reach this 
point. Winning a few graded races along 
the way.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe, I'm sorry about back then. 
But...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad that I can compete with you like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
""Happy"... Neo Universe is "missing". 
But..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: It's "XACF."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text: Zaku... Sifu?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yes... "XACF"...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You're using such difficult words... as 
usual.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Even so, that's precisely why I want you 
to let me confirm it today.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...See you in the race then.

The Trainer walks away with a meaningful 
look on their face.

After she left, I called out to Neo 
Universe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Destiny"...

It probably means something close to 
"destiny." If I had to make an educated 
guess...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Trainer. Neo Universe will overcome 
it—her "destiny."

――A "fated" reunion. The meaning of our 
parting that day...

"It looks like that will be put to the 
test on the stage of this Satsuki Sho."
